Issue #1: 26C: 19 former opt-ins now standard, plus HCM pages moving to Redwood

17 Oct 2026 · Oracle Fusion 26C

19 former opt-ins are now standard across Financials, Projects and Supply Chain in 26C (14 switched on automatically, 5 need setup if you want them), and HCM pages are moving to Redwood. Plus the 8 changes worth your time and what to check now that you're on 26C.
